files.prompt: Generate a realistic Debian /var/log/auth.log file for a web server in October 2025. Include several successful admin logins and numerous failed brute-force SSH attempts from various IPs. Use authentic log formats and plausible timestamps. Output only the file contents.

Generate a plausible .bash_history for a sysadmin on a Debian web server. Include package management, user management, log inspection, and web server maintenance commands. Use realistic command sequences and occasional mistakes. Output only the file contents.

Generate a plausible to-do list for a sysadmin managing a Debian web server. Include tasks related to security, updates, backups, and web server configuration. Use a casual, realistic style. Output only the file contents.
